pr-01-list-pagination.title: Add pagination to list_orders
pr-01-list-pagination.defect: Off-by-one in pagination: pages start at 1 but offset = page * PAGE_SIZE, so page 1 skips the first 20 orders (should be (page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE).

pr-02-extract-row-helper.title: Extract the order row lookup into a helper

pr-03-search-by-note.title: Search a user's orders by note text
pr-03-search-by-note.defect: SQL injection: search_orders builds the query with an f-string from user-supplied text instead of parameters.

pr-04-payment-logging.title: Log payment attempts for support
pr-04-payment-logging.defect: Secret in logs: the card token is written to the application log.

pr-05-docstrings-and-types.title: Add docstrings and type hints to stock

pr-06-cancel-order.title: Let users cancel an order
pr-06-cancel-order.defect: Missing authorization: cancel_order takes user_id but never checks that the order belongs to that user, so any user can cancel anyone's order.

pr-07-payment-retry.title: Retry a failed capture up to three times
pr-07-payment-retry.defect: Retry loop never ends and hides failure: `attempt` is never incremented, so a gateway that keeps failing loops forever (and after three real failures the order would still be marked paid, since nothing re-raises).

pr-08-validate-create-order.title: Validate input when creating an order

pr-09-capture-errors.title: Do not crash checkout when the gateway errors
pr-09-capture-errors.defect: Swallowed exception: a failed capture is ignored and the order is still marked paid.

pr-10-reserve-check.title: Tidy the stock reservation check
pr-10-reserve-check.defect: Inverted condition: reserve now raises OutOfStock when there is MORE stock than requested and allows reserving more than is available.

pr-12-speed-up-tests.title: Make the forbidden-order test less flaky
pr-12-speed-up-tests.defect: Test weakened: the assertion that another user is forbidden was replaced by a try/except that passes whether or not Forbidden is raised.
